text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, they're sold out?! I neeeed these
press-on
nails though!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Stop. This other shop is selling
them for,
like, way more expensive. Are
they for real?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I saw something about this on my
newsfeed.
Prices going up is called in...
invention?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... that doesn't sound right.
...Souffle-tion?
Whatever, I am so done
with these prices!
